notes.title: Update 1.10 is Out!
notes.notes:
[h3]Good Sol to You, Strategists![/h3]

This update includes several improvements designed to enhance your gameplay experience:
[list]
[*] [b]Animated Intro[/b]: Immerse yourself with the new animated introduction.
[*] [b]Wave Variability[/b]: Encounter more diverse and challenging waves of enemies, keeping every battle fresh.
[*] [b]Rebalanced Enemies[/b]: Enjoy a more balanced combat experience with reworked enemy stats and behaviours.
[*] [b]Various Fixes[/b]: Bug-fixes and minor improvements.
[/list]
I also wish to inform you that the Journal feature has been postponed to Update 1.20. I apologise for the delay and appreciate your understanding as I continue to refine this key aspect of the game.

[h3]These updates improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/h3]

notes.title: [Update 1.00.8] Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]New Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bugfix: [/b]Resolved the 'Master Strategist' achievement issue.
[*] [b]Bugfix: [/b]Fixed the blinking tooltip in certain situations.
[*] [b]Progress Reset: [/b]Nullified values in stats after resetting progress.
[*] [b]Game Logic: [/b]Enhanced game sequencing logic for smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Settings: [/b]Fixed jitteriness in the settings scroll.
[/list]

[h3]These updates enhance stability and improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/h3]
